similarGamesIntro: Looking for more games like this? Try the picks beside or below — same vibe, a slightly different way to win.

howToPlayBody.arcade: Stay on beat, react fast, and chase a high score. One mistap restarts the run — learn the pattern, then beat your own record.
howToPlayBody.puzzle: Read the board, find combos, and clear tiles in the right order. Speed is optional; every move sets up the next chain.
howToPlayBody.action: Dodge, strike, and survive each room. Hits land as you move — positioning matters more than button-mashing.
howToPlayBody.io: Join a busy lobby, grow, and avoid getting eaten. Watch the map, split at the right time, and always leave an exit.
howToPlayBody.racing: Hold your line, boost at the right moment, and stay on track. The last lap is the one that counts.
howToPlayBody.simulation: Build, upgrade, and keep the loop running. Start small, then expand once income is stable.
howToPlayBody.strategy: Take tiles, place units, and read the other side. Save resources for the push that actually ends the match.
howToPlayBody.sports: Timing the shot matters more than holding the ball. Learn the opponent pattern, then change pace.
howToPlayBody.clicker: Tap to earn, buy upgrades, then let idle income run. Come back when a big upgrade is ready.
howToPlayBody.adventure: Explore each area, pick up relics, and unlock new paths. Check the corners — stars and shortcuts hide there.
